verdict.rationale: Aleph documents a connector library spanning ERP, HRIS, and CRM systems (150+ no-code integrations). It also documents headcount planning backed by live HRIS/ATS/ERP data, plus consolidation that combines tables into a single source of truth alongside the financials. This covers the core of pulling headcount and CRM data into the same model as the books. missing for 10: explicit payroll connectors, explicit CRM pipeline modeling, a named list of specific HRIS/CRM connectors, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
